Overview.Name: Naga Sainath Therala
Overview.Goal: Improve overall health, manage weight, and prevent future lifestyle-related issues through clean and structured eating.

Meal_1_Morning_or_Brunch: 2–3 whole eggs (if acceptable) or 100g paneer cooked in ghee
1 small bowl rice with cooked vegetables (bottle gourd, ridge gourd, beans, or spinach)
Add a small portion of ghee to rice for satiety
Meal_2_Evening_or_Early_Dinner: 150g paneer or tofu lightly cooked in butter or ghee
1 small bowl rice or millet with cooked vegetables
Snack_Optional_Afternoon: Roasted makhana or puffed rice mixed with a spoon of ghee and a pinch of salt

Notes_and_Tips: Prioritize whole ingredients like eggs, paneer, curd, rice, and vegetables — avoid processed foods, biscuits, and seed oils.
Since you have less than 6 hours of sleep and a desk job, focus on walking after meals to improve metabolism.
Try to increase sleep duration to at least 7 hours for better weight management and hormonal balance.
Eat slowly and stop at comfortable fullness — this supports digestion and helps prevent overeating.
Keep meals simple and repetitive if needed; consistency matters more than variety right now.
Avoid snacking late at night and try to keep a 3-hour gap before bedtime after dinner.
This plan will help you feel lighter, reduce bloating, and gradually improve overall health markers like energy, digestion, and body composition.
